name: gmkit-monorepo
description: GMKit polyglot monorepo for Java and TypeScript packages

scripts.verify: npm run test:ts && npm run test:java && npm run parity && npm run build:ts && npm run test:package -w packages/ts
scripts.test:ts: npm run type-check -w packages/ts && npm test -w packages/ts
scripts.test:java: npm run test:sm9-bundle && mvn -f packages/java/pom.xml -B -ntp test
scripts.parity: mvn -f packages/java/pom.xml -B -ntp -pl gmkit -Dtest=InteropComplianceTest test && npm exec -w packages/ts -- vitest run test/interop-compliance.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.docs:verify: npm run build:ts && npm run docs:generate-api && npm run docs:check-api && npm run docs:check && npm run docs:check-deploy && npm run docs:test-examples && npm run docs:build && npm run docs:check-links
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:generate-api && npm run dev -w docs/site
